summary.text: Jayson Ameer Rasheed is the Democratic candidate for the Ohio House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as educator and administrator.

paragraphs.text: Jayson Ameer Rasheed earned a bachelor's degree from Wilmington College in 2000, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an educator and a product of public schools with over 20 years in education and athletics.
He said he moved back to Ohio to take care of his mother.
Rasheed said he would work for fair school funding, expand career and technical pathways, and support educators.
He also said he supports workers' rights to organize and bargain collectively, livable wages, affordable housing, childcare access and lower healthcare burdens.
